build: Modwerk's linker: core-ar2 0.7 + this folder's Chromatic Aftertouch Fix 0.1.0-experimental, materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version CA01

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: rytm-emu 2ac0f1f, no card image, JIT on

conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the boot notices; GLOBAL, three DOWNs and YES open MIDI CONFIG; DOWN and YES open PORT CONFIG; DOWNs move to PRESSURE DST. Defaults untouched. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified.

captures.plan: dtboot CA01.syx --instr 8000M --every 1000M --save boot.snap; dtboot CA01.syx --load boot.snap --instr 2000M --every 1000M --press NO@8203M:60M --press NO@8503M:60M --press NO@8803M:60M --press NO@9103M:60M --save main.snap; DTBOOT_STEPS=1 DTBOOT_PNG_DIR=out dtboot CA01.syx --load main.snap --instr 5500M --every 1000M --press GLOBAL@10303M, DOWN at 10703M 10953M 11203M, YES@11553M, DOWN@11903M, YES@12253M, then DOWN every 250M from 12603M, ten times
